title: Let idle Stop reconfirm a pending test-run wait retirement
outcome: Let idle Stop reconfirm a pending test-run wait retirement
acceptance: When a first idle Stop is awaiting or has failed to confirm its parent row, a repeated Stop for a session with only that test-run wait can confirm the same pause without a 409 or a duplicate stopped message.
A behavioral fixture covers the still-pending retirement on the normal Stop route.
